annotations.text:
Direction A, "Instrument": cool paper, hairline rules, mono numerals. Two accents that MEAN something - blue for the system's answer, warm for where it disagrees with itself or declines to answer. Boldness spent only in the hero.

Both accents sit at oklch L 0.52, measured at 5.00:1 and 5.36:1 on this paper. They started at 0.55, where the blue measured 4.40:1 and failed.

Every number and every shape on these two boards is generated from the same vendored JSON the real site uses - no hand-copied figures. Two errors this caught:

- The frame is 720x480, not 1280x720. At the wrong size every right-side box drew INSIDE the frame, which is the opposite of the point.
- The chart used to show two classifiers on one transcript (17/47 agree). The headline is about swapping the TRANSCRIBER (61.9% over 2,737 shared seconds), so the tracks now show that instead.
Two alternates on different axes, kept low-fi on purpose: picking a direction does not need polish. Each carries its own tradeoff. Say which to pursue and it gets built into the Site page.
